validity.recommendation: Do not treat 'Guigang-Yulin Branch' as a confirmed distinct project without going back to a primary approval/EIA document that actually names a Guigang-to-Yulin route. Verify whether P4717 is (a) really the '玉林支线'/Yulin Branch (Beihai LNG terminal -> Yulin, 137.7 km) mislabeled with the wrong start endpoint, (b) really the separate '贵港支线'/Guigang Branch (Nanning -> Guigang, 50 km) mislabeled with the wrong length, or (c) a genuine but separately-sourced Guigang-to-Yulin line for which no corroborating document has yet been found. Cross-check against the wiki page's own 'Beihai LNG-Guigang Pipeline (Proposed)' entry, which may be the true home for the Guigang-side data. Until resolved, the row's Location and any implied length are unverified.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM's own gem.wiki page for this shared network names this segment 'Guigang–Yulin Branch 玉林支线 (贵港-玉林)', Status=Cancelled, Length=137.7 km cited to footnote [16] (cite_note-:0-16, sheet's harvested URL https://gas.in-en.com/html/gas-3040179.shtml). Two independent problems: (1) that cited URL (an NDRC-style approval notice for the unrelated Fusui-Chongzuo branch, per its own link text) now 404s -- it is dead and, going by its own title, never actually supported this segment. (2) I went to the ONE source gem.wiki's editors plausibly built the 137.7 km figure from -- a Dec 2011 EIA article republished on ifeng.com (广西液化天然气（LNG）项目环境影响评价, 广西新闻网, 2011-12-01) -- verified live (200) and containing both '贵港' and '137.7'. That article lists the ORIGINAL 2011 Guangxi LNG terminal-transport network as one 684.17 km trunk (Beihai-Hechi) plus SIX separate named branches, each with its own length and route: 粤西支线 187.2 km (Beihai-Maoming via Yulin), 玉林支线 (Yulin Branch) 137.7 km explicitly routed Beihai->Yulin ('玉林支线先后经过北海、玉林2个地市'), 防城港支线 70.44 km, 桂林支线 172.37 km, 柳州支线 35.0 km, and a SEPARATE 贵港支线 (Guigang Branch) 50.0 km routed Nanning->Guigang ('贵港支线先后经过南宁、贵港2个地市'). Nowhere in this primary source is there a combined 'Guigang-Yulin' branch -- Guigang and Yulin are the endpoints of two DIFFERENT spurs off the main trunk, not two ends of one line. GEM's wiki entry appears to have grafted the Yulin Branch's length (137.7 km) onto a name/endpoint pair ('Guigang-Yulin') that matches neither the Yulin Branch (Beihai->Yulin) nor the Guigang Branch (Nanning->Guigang) as documented in 2011. On the actual GEM sheet itself the row carries no Length/Diameter/Capacity at all (worklist shows only Status/Fuel/Location units, all MISSING_REF) -- so the sheet doesn't inherit the wiki's mismatched number, but the Location value (StartPrefecture=Guigang, EndPrefecture=Yulin) does inherit the questionable naming. I searched independently in Chinese (贵港-玉林 天然气管道; 贵玉支线 天然气管道; 广西天然气支线管网 贵港 玉林 项目核准) and found no approval notice, news article, or EIA that names a single Guigang-to-Yulin gas transmission line, cancelled or otherwise. Given (a) the row's only traceable citation is dead/mismatched, (b) the one plausible source it could derive from actually describes two different, non-contiguous spurs, and (c) no independent source names this combined route at all, I'm flagging this as an existence/attribution concern rather than accepting it as a distinct confirmed project. This is NOT a call that the underlying network/branches don't exist -- the 2011 EIA is solid, live evidence that Guangxi's LNG-terminal transport network did plan both a Yulin-bound spur and a Guigang-bound spur -- it's a call that P4717 as currently named/located does not clearly correspond to either.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Cannot independently confirm or refute 'cancelled' as the current status because the identity of the segment itself is in doubt (see validity finding). The gem.wiki page's own 'Status: Cancelled' tag for this entry carries NO footnote at all in the raw wiki markup -- it is an unsourced GEM editorial judgment, not traceable to any dated source. The one citation attached to this entry (footnote [16], length figure) is a dead link (404) whose own link text is about an unrelated approval (Fusui-Chongzuo branch). I searched for later news of either a 'Yulin Branch' or 'Guigang Branch' gas line status (built/cancelled/superseded) in Chinese -- queries: 贵港 玉林 天然气支线 取消; 广西天然气支线管网 贵港 玉林 支线 项目核准 -- and found nothing dated after the 2011 EIA that speaks to this specific route's fate. Other 2011-era branches on the same shared wiki page (e.g. Liuzhou, Zhakou/main trunk) are now recorded as operating, so it's plausible this particular spur really was dropped in favor of later, differently-routed approvals (Hepu-Bobai-Pubei, Nanning-Pingxiang, etc., which are tracked as separate PIDs under 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network'), but that is inference, not evidence. Given the underlying identity problem, I'm marking this 'unclear' rather than 'confirm' -- a status verdict on a mis-specified entity isn't meaningful. Recommend resolving the existence/attribution concern first; a status call can follow once the route is correctly identified.
status_reviews.wiki_note: The wiki page's raw markup for this entry (fetched via reader-mode) reads verbatim: 'Guigang–Yulin Branch 玉林支线 (贵港-玉林) / Parent company: Sinopec[11] / Capacity: / Length: 137.7 kilometers[16] / Status: Cancelled / Start year:' -- confirming Status carries no citation of its own.

summary: P4717 ('Guigang-Yulin Branch', cancelled): flagged existence/attribution concern -- its only traceable citation is a dead/mismatched link, and the one plausible primary source (a live 2011 Guangxi-LNG EIA) describes two separate, non-contiguous spurs (Yulin Branch: Beihai->Yulin, 137.7km; Guigang Branch: Nanning->Guigang, 50km) rather than any single Guigang-to-Yulin line; status_review verdict=unclear since the unsourced 'cancelled' tag can't be confirmed or refuted independently while the segment's identity itself is in doubt. No fills staged (UNRESOLVED) given the open concern.
